question: Did this compact graph reach the target on each fixed cohort at its domain end, then suffer a net loss by S19?
why_needed: Initial-to-final learning is real but does not distinguish a domain-end deficit from subsequent net loss. This distinction changes whether a later framework needs to supply missing function or retain function that was already present.
corrected_initial_proposal: S1/S12/S13/S14 was wrong; medical is T2-11, geography T12-15, finance T16, traffic T17-19. No model or protocol was executed with the mistaken mapping.
possible_readouts: Exactly 20 original explored DEV per non-traffic domain at the fixed domain-end snapshot: 80 new generations/scores. S19 traffic and all final F1 are copied from the sealed current VERIFIED, never rescored. No historical peak selection.
reconstruction_requirements: Each state starts from the original fresh base, fixed visual asset and that stage's complete cumulative 96 FP32 A/B snapshot; never add snapshots or refold an already folded graph.
Bind snapshot digest, exact keys/shapes/dtypes, and original frozen-parameter mask/digest before freezing the restored whole graph.
Use the identical inherited CPU FP32 fold followed by FP16 storage and preserve FP32 RoPE.
An S19 zero-generation reconstruction must match the sealed final full-graph digest within the same new readout; charge its reconstruction cost.
Bind all actual text/features/references/generation settings to the sealed original 100 DEV. No new training, teacher, NLL, TEST, recovery or candidate selection.

result_dependent_design_use.domain_end_reaches_target_but_final_fall: The target was attainable on that fixed cohort before later stages; a subsequent design must account for retaining that function.
result_dependent_design_use.domain_end_below_target: Reject the claim that the entire deficit arose after that domain ended; this does not identify capacity or exclude within-domain forgetting.
result_dependent_design_use.mixed: Retain a mixed functional diagnosis; do not automatically select a memory or transfer algorithm.

limits: Call this domain-end performance, not strictly just-acquired performance. The full parent's final floor is a design target, not a matched-stage parent control. No pure forgetting/capacity causality, significance, or claim that any retention method suffices.
